test.description: fill-extrusion cast-shadows sticky-cache rescale path (§3.10). The map loads and refits the light-clip frustum at zoom 16.5 (cachedZoom = 16.5), then zooms in to 16.8 -- a <0.58 zoom-in that stays within the oversized cached coverage, so it is served as a RESCALED cache hit (liveS = exp2(0.3) ~= 1.23, no caster re-render) rather than a refit. This golden proves the rescaled cascade matrices still sample the cached depth map correctly (crisp shadow, no drift/misalignment) on the liveS != 1 path. The cache-present-vs-forced-always-refit BIT identity is unit-covered in shadow_cache.test.ts and the settled-frame render identity is covered by the browser oscillation test.
